reviewMethod: Reviewed a labeled 14-image contact sheet of coordinate-centered 2025 USDA NAIP crops for Greensboro and Winston-Salem. Four linear greenways were recentered on reviewed OpenStreetMap way geometry and inspected again at tighter scale. Each park selection depicts the named grounds; each greenway selection depicts a documented representative segment. Source, acquisition, crop, and public-domain metadata remain in the candidate file.
